title: Wi-Fi password rejected
symptom: Laptop will not join the office Wi-Fi, password rejected
user_description: I'm trying to connect my laptop to the office Wi-Fi but it keeps saying the password is wrong.

options.text: Change the Wi-Fi password for the whole office
options.why: Disconnects every device in the company to fix one person's typing. Wildly out of proportion.

options.text: Make sure she picked the correct network name and type the password slowly and carefully, remembering it is case sensitive
options.why: Choosing the wrong network (such as the guest one) or a mistyped, case-sensitive password are the most common causes. Check these simple things first.

options.text: Switch the office Wi-Fi to open with no password
options.why: Removes security for everyone. Never weaken security to make one device connect.

hints: Is she connecting to the right network name?
real_world_tip: Offices often have a staff network and a guest network. Users picking the wrong one is a surprisingly common cause.
